metadata.description: List title of the Master Config list
List title of the new list that contains the child lists of the extenders
Delete to recycle bin or permanent delete
URL of the site where all the lists are
Name of the environment - dev / staging / prod - for logging purpose only
List of email addresses to send email alerts- separate multiple values by semicolon

runError.message: Target site is not present in AllowedSites whitelist.
CleanupTestDate cannot be used in Production. Must use Created or Modified.

Compose_CamlQuery_Keyset.inputs: @if(equals(variables('varLastId'), 0), concat('<View><Query><Where><Lt><FieldRef Name=''', variables('varCleanupDateField'), '''/><Value Type=''DateTime'' IncludeTimeValue=''TRUE''>', outputs('Compose_CutoffDate'), '</Value></Lt></Where><OrderBy><FieldRef Name=''ID'' Ascending=''TRUE''/></OrderBy></Query><ViewFields><FieldRef Name=''ID''/><FieldRef Name=''Title''/><FieldRef Name=''', variables('varCleanupDateField'), '''/></ViewFields><RowLimit Paged=''TRUE''>', variables('varBatchSize'), '</RowLimit></View>'), concat('<View><Query><Where><And><Gt><FieldRef Name=''ID''/><Value Type=''Counter''>', variables('varLastId'), '</Value></Gt><Lt><FieldRef Name=''', variables('varCleanupDateField'), '''/><Value Type=''DateTime'' IncludeTimeValue=''TRUE''>', outputs('Compose_CutoffDate'), '</Value></Lt></And></Where><OrderBy><FieldRef Name=''ID'' Ascending=''TRUE''/></OrderBy></Query><ViewFields><FieldRef Name=''ID''/><FieldRef Name=''Title''/><FieldRef Name=''', variables('varCleanupDateField'), '''/></ViewFields><RowLimit Paged=''TRUE''>', variables('varBatchSize'), '</RowLimit></View>'))

inputs.select:
@if(
  variables('varUseRecycleBin'),
  concat(
    '--', outputs('Compose_ChangesetGuid'), decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Content-Type: application/http', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'POST ', items('Each_TargetList')?['SiteUrl'], '/_api/web/lists/getbytitle(''', items('Each_TargetList')?['ListName'], ''')/items(', item()?['ID'], ')/recycle() HTTP/1.1', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Accept: application/json;odata=nometadata', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Content-Length: 0', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A')
  ),
  concat(
    '--', outputs('Compose_ChangesetGuid'), decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Content-Type: application/http', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'DELETE ', items('Each_TargetList')?['SiteUrl'], '/_api/web/lists/getbytitle(''', items('Each_TargetList')?['ListName'], ''')/items(', item()?['ID'], ') HTTP/1.1', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Accept: application/json;odata=nometadata', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'IF-MATCH: *', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    'Content-Length: 0', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'),
    decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A')
  )
)

Compose_FullBatchPayload.inputs: @concat('--', outputs('Compose_BatchGuid'), decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'), 'Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=', outputs('Compose_ChangesetGuid'), decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'), decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'), outputs('Compose_JoinedOperations'), '--', outputs('Compose_ChangesetGuid'), '--', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'), '--', outputs('Compose_BatchGuid'), '--', decodeUriComponent('%0D%0A'))

Compose_ListErrorLog.inputs: Cleanup failed on target list: @{items('Each_TargetList')?['ListName']}. Error Details: @{result('TargetList_ExecutionScope')}

Compose_HtmlEmailBody.inputs:
SharePoint Cleanup Execution Report

Mode: @{variables('varMode')}  |  Completed: @{utcNow('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')} UTC

Target Site @{variables('varSiteUrl')}
Run ID @{variables('varRunId')}
Total Candidates Found @{variables('varTotalCandidates')}
Total Succeeded @{variables('varTotalDeleted')}
Total Failed @{variables('varTotalFailed')}
